verdict.summary: This layer covers 20 criteria: 17 by deterministic rules and 17 by the trained scorer, overlapping. Other criteria are unchecked, not clean.

findings.issue: Navigating changed the page but not its title, so the screen reader still announces the previous page — a user who checks where they are is told the wrong thing
findings.evidence: after activating "You Tube Home, link" the page moved to "main landmark, Try searching to get started, heading, level 2" while the title stayed "Home | Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI) | W3C"

conformance.name: Conformance Level
conformance.establishes: Assessed 20 of 55 WCAG 2.2 A/AA success criteria.
conformance.limitation: No conformance level is claimed or established. 35 criteria were NOT assessed and are unchecked, not clean. A conforming alternate version, if this page has one, is not detected.

conformance.name: Full pages
conformance.establishes: Every structural sweep ran until the page ran out of elements, so the parts of the page a screen reader can reach were examined in full. Reach, as distinct announcements the screen reader produced against DISTINCT NAMES the browser reports — like compared with like: heading 19/19, landmark 15/13, link 13/70 of 75 on the page, graphic 1/3. A shortfall here is a coverage question about this tool, not a finding about the page.
conformance.limitation: One viewport, one state, one document. Responsive VARIATIONS each have to conform separately and only one was rendered; content inside iframes is not entered; and WCAG counts an application at a single URI as ONE page, so every state reachable without a URL change — menus, dialogs, steps of a wizard — is part of this page and was not examined. Document e506c2d0: served https://www.w3.org/WAI/ titled "Home | Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI) | W3C" (document). Render (domCensus): tabbable=78, formField=1, link=75, landmark=13, heading=19, graphic=2. Every one of the 18 form control(s) found was offered to the activation probe.

conformance.name: Complete processes
conformance.establishes: Findings are scoped to this single page.
conformance.limitation: If this page is one step of a process — signing in, checking out, completing a multi-step form — the other steps were not assessed, and WCAG conformance for the process cannot be claimed from this run. See docs/adr/0011-task-journeys.md. Third-party content (embeds, adverts, widgets) is also not distinguished from the author's own, so a finding may concern content they cannot control — the case WCAG §5.4 covers with a statement of partial conformance.

conformance.name: Only Accessibility-Supported Ways of Using Technologies
conformance.establishes: Evidence is what NVDA 2026.1.1 driving Microsoft Edge 151.0.4129.72 actually announced, so support is demonstrated rather than inferred from markup.
conformance.limitation: Accessibility support was demonstrated for that one combination only. Other screen readers, browsers and platforms behave differently and were not assessed, and one language version was read with one synthesiser — §5.5 requires each language offered to conform on its own. Nor was this page checked with the technology it relies on turned OFF or unsupported, which §5.2.5 also requires.

conformance.name: Non-Interference
conformance.establishes: Of the four criteria that apply to ALL content, assessed: 1.4.2, 2.1.2.
conformance.limitation: NOT assessed: 2.2.2, 2.3.1. These apply to all content on the page whether or not it is relied upon, so they cannot be assumed satisfied. 2.3.1 Three Flashes is visual and belongs to the rule-based layer, which ran.
